info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Management API
info.description: The Customer Management API facilitates the creation and management of customer profiles within the system. This endpoint is designed to handle the addition of new customer data by utilizing the customer ID for identification. Businesses can leverage this API to streamline customer onboarding and enhance service personalization. Typical consumers include developers looking to integrate customer management functionalities into their applications or systems, allowing for improved customer relationship management.

post.description: This endpoint creates a new customer with the provided details. You must specify all necessary fields in the request body to successfully create the customer record.
